name: The Road In
description: The flourish is pure texture and never costs anything on any result.

dc.basis: level 1 DC 15, one step easy — this is a treat, not a test

outcomes.criticalSuccess: It's genuinely cool, and somebody in the queue notices.
outcomes.failure: A small, funny stumble — a dropped kickstand, the wrong door, nothing that matters.
outcomes.criticalFailure: Comically embarrassing, entirely harmless — it stalls right in front of everyone.

notes:
a-flourish is never mandatory and never worth offering more than once per player; if nobody wants it, the scene loses nothing.

A second check, the-trap-on-the-fence (an Encyclopaedia check about a mitflit trap glimpsed on arrival), was cut entirely 2026-09-09 -- see the scene brief's own notes and ideas/story/bible/species/mitflits.md. This scene may gain a different Encyclopaedia check here once a replacement mystery is chosen.
